title: Kilo Architecture Ratchet Allowlist
description: Baseline exception list for Kilo-owned domain architecture boundaries and state ratchets on the v2 package layout. Upstream-owned shared opencode files are exempt to prevent upstream merge conflicts. As Kilo legacy sites are refactored into clean Effect layers, decrement counts or remove entries to lock in progress.

core-directionality.description: Forbidden imports in packages/schema/src, packages/core/src, packages/protocol/src, and packages/client/src. Target: domain packages depend only in the allowed direction.

kilo-gateway-core-isolation.description: Imports from @opencode/* in packages/kilo-gateway-core/src. Target: Kilo logic packages stay independent of @opencode/*.

kilo-instance-state.description: Legacy InstanceState.make usages in Kilo-owned code (packages/kilo-*/src/**, packages/*/src/kilocode/**). Target: encapsulate in scoped Effect Services in packages/core.

kilo-database-constructors.description: Direct new Database() / new DatabaseSync() instantiations in Kilo-owned code. Target: all persistence routes through core Database.Service.

packages/kilo-cli/src/migration/cutover..reason: On the private stage verify the completed candidate and checkpoint its receipt before atomic publication. The server must not own this connection.

packages/kilo-cli/src/migration/owner.ts.reason: The migration lock is a separate SQLite file, not a session store. Consent may create it, recovery must open an existing file, and an observer uses a read-only connection to test the owner's exclusive lock.

packages/kilo-cli/src/migration/project-.reason: Inventory project paths from standalone files or a private snapshot before conversion replaces the old workspace tables. The immutable connection does not create SQLite sidecars.

packages/kilo-cli/src/migration/publish..reason: Publication needs an exclusive SQLite connection to an existing file and an independent reader to verify that the lock actually excludes clients before replacing the file.

packages/kilo-cli/src/migration/receipt..reason: Before normal database startup, read the checkpointed receipt immutably to verify this launcher's selected inputs. Starting Database.Service to authorize its own startup would be too late.

packages/kilo-cli/src/migration/snapshot.reason: Snapshot capture pins a reader, reserves the writer slot and opens an independent VACUUM INTO reader to include committed WAL frames. Two verification connections operate only on the staged copy: one normalizes its journal mode and one checks it immutably. The original must not run schema migrations.

packages/kilo-cli/src/migration/verify-p.reason: After an interrupted publication, verify the standalone published store against the attached v1 recovery file with immutable reads. Recovery must not upgrade or write either file to establish which history survived.

packages/kilo-cli/src/sqlite-readonly.ts.reason: Read-only opens of a Kilo v1 store or an earlier kilo store before any server starts: the import v1 source, the copy of an earlier build, and the startup guard that refuses a v1 store. One open reads a store in use with locks; the other is an immutable open for a store at rest, which creates no file beside it. Database.Service would run migrations on these files, which must stay as they are.

kilo-tool-process-env.description: Direct process.env reads in Kilo-owned tools. Target: pass configuration explicitly via Tool.Context or Env.Service.

kilo-httpapi-handlers.description: Raw OS or process operations in Kilo-owned HTTP handler files. Target: delegate to domain Effect services.
